# Cooking with Manuela

> > A home cooking blog featuring authentic Italian recipes, traditional desserts, and seasonal baking by Manuela, author of The Complete Italian Cookbook.

Cooking with Manuela showcases regional Italian cuisine alongside creative seasonal recipes, from classic desserts like Panna Cotta, Tiramisu, and Torta della Nonna to modern twists on traditional dishes. The site features both authentic Italian techniques and approachable home baking for all skill levels.

## Key Topics

- Italian desserts
- Traditional Italian baking
- Panna Cotta
- Tiramisu
- Torta della Nonna
- Neapolitan pizza
- Ricotta-based recipes
- Seasonal baking
- No-bake desserts
- Banana bread variations
- Holiday recipes
- Italian cuisine techniques
- Regional Italian cooking
- Quick breads
- Chocolate desserts

## Featured & Essential Recipes

- [The Complete Italian Cookbook - Essential Regional Cooking of Italy](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2020/03/the-complete-italian-cookbook-essential.html): Announcement of Manuela's first cookbook on regional Italian cuisine
- [How to Make Authentic Neapolitan Pizza Dough (Pizza Napoletana)](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2022/08/how-to-make-authentic-neapolitan-pizza.html): Authentic Neapolitan pizza dough recipe with traditional Italian method
- [Most Popular Recipes of 2022](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2022/12/most-popular-recipes-of-2022.html): Year-end roundup of 2022's top recipes including Torta della Nonna
- [Italian Gluten-Free Almond-Orange Cake](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2022/12/italian-gluten-free-almond-orange-cake.html): Flourless Italian almond-orange torta, gluten-free and easy to make

## Traditional Italian Desserts

- [Traditional Panna Cotta with Strawberry Sauce](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2019/04/blog-post.html): Traditional Italian panna cotta with sweet strawberry sauce
- [Made-from-Scratch Ricotta and Berry Tart](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2016/11/made-from-scratch-ricotta-and-berry-tart.html): Homemade ricotta and berry tart with from-scratch crust recipe
- [Espresso Brownies with Mascarpone Cream](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2026/01/espresso-brownies-with-mascarpone-cream.html): Tiramisu-style brownie bars with espresso and mascarpone cream

## Italian Savory Dishes

- [Italian Bruschetta with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes Recipe](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2024/06/italian-bruschetta-with-roasted-cherry.html): Italian bruschetta with roasted tomatoes, burrata, and pesto
- [The Best Italian Summer Pasta Salad with Sun-Dried Tomatoes Pesto](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2024/07/the-best-italian-summer-pasta-salad.html): Italian pasta salad with sun-dried tomatoes, tuna, and arugula
- [How to Create a Three-Level Holiday Charcuterie Board](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2017/11/charcuterie-board.html): Three-tier holiday charcuterie board guide featuring Les Trois Petits

## Quick Breads & Muffins

- [Irresistibly Moist and Soft Blueberry Banana Bread](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2023/08/blueberry-banana-bread.html): Moist blueberry banana bread with one-bowl quick bread recipe
- [Soft and Moist Pumpkin Banana Bread with Chocolate Chips](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2024/11/soft-and-moist-pumpkin-banana-bread.html): Fall pumpkin banana bread with chocolate chips and warm spices
- [Lemon-Blueberry Ricotta Muffins Easy Recipe](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2024/07/lemon-blueberry-ricotta-muffins-easy.html): Soft ricotta muffins with blueberries and lemon flavor

## Holiday & Seasonal Baking

- [Picture-Perfect Christmas Tree Cupcakes](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2021/12/picture-perfect-christmas-tree-cupcakes.html): Vanilla cupcakes with Christmas tree decoration and cream cheese frosting
- [Heart Thumbprint Cookies](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2023/02/heart-thumbprint-cookies.html): Valentine's Day thumbprint cookies with strawberry jam hearts
- [Halloween Corn Pops Mummy Treats](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2020/10/halloween-corn-pops-mummy-treats.html): No-bake Halloween mummy treats with Kellogg's Corn Pops cereal
- [Raspberry and Chocolate Cheesecake Bars](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2018/12/raspberry-and-chocolate-cheesecake-bars.html): Holiday raspberry cheesecake bars with Philadelphia cream cheese

## Optional

- [S'More Cookie Cups](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2018/08/smore-cookie-cups.html): S'more cookie cups with chocolate ganache and marshmallow topping
- [Soft Pretzel Hearts Stuffed with Ricotta Cheese and Strawberry Preserve](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2017/04/soft-pretzel-hearts.html): Heart-shaped soft pretzels stuffed with ricotta and Bonne Maman preserves
- [Apple and Aloe Vera Yogurt Cake](https://www.cookingwithmanuela.com/2018/09/apple-yogurt-cake.html): Fall apple cake made with Alove aloe vera yogurt
